According to arXiv 2404.13060, it is insufficient to audit only the final AI product because AI systems pose risks that change over time, and black-box systems cannot necessarily be evaluated solely as a final product. This is due to the potential for imperceptible training data attacks that can affect the final model. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the entire process, not just the product. 

The recommended additional processes include auditing the inputs and training processes, conducting ethical audits of data sources and human curation, and integrating specific model evaluation techniques with the auditing process. This broader approach is necessary to address the complex relationships between individual changes in AI systems and the associated ethical and safety concerns.
